updates.title: Updates
updates.scope: For this app, across all workspaces
updates.background: Updates download in the background. You choose when to restart.
updates.readyDetail: The update is verified and ready to install.
updates.restartIdle: Situate will save your work, install the update and restart.
updates.restartWorking: Actions are running in one or more workspaces. You can update later, or stop the actions and restart now.
updates.restartCaution: You can continue affected chats by sending another message after the restart.
updates.forceWarning: Situate will stop running actions and restart without waiting for open windows to save. Unsaved changes in any window may be lost. Save anything you need before continuing.
updates.recoveryDetail: Quit Situate, then install a trusted copy of the update version or a newer release. If it won’t quit normally, use macOS Force Quit; unsaved changes may be lost. Do not delete or reset your workspaces.
